verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ Τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Ἐφέσῳ καὶ πιστοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Paulos apostolos Christou Iēsou dia thelēmatos Theou Tois hagiois tois ousin en Ephesō kai pistois en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Paul an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God To the saints - in Ephesus the faithful in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Paulo, apóstolo de Cristo Jesus por vontade de Deus, aos santos que estão em Éfeso e fiéis em Cristo Jesus:

verses.original: Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis hymin kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros hēmōn kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Graça a vós e paz da parte de Deus, nosso Pai, e da do Senhor Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ πνευματικῇ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Eulogētos ho Theos kai Patēr tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou ho eulogēsas hēmas en pasē eulogia pneumatikē en tois epouraniois en Christō
verses.literal: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms
verses.literalPt: Bendito o Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que nos abençoou com toda a bênção espiritual nas regiões celestes em Cristo,

verses.original: καθὼς ἐξελέξατο ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτῷ πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: kathōs exelexato hēmas en autō pro katabolēs kosmou einai hēmas hagious kai amōmous katenōpion autou en agapē
verses.literal: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence . . . In love
verses.literalPt: assim como nos escolheu, nele, antes da fundação, do mundo para sermos santos e sem defeito perante ele;

verses.original: προορίσας ἡμᾶς εἰς υἱοθεσίαν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς αὐτόν κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: proorisas hēmas eis huiothesian dia Iēsou Christou eis auton kata tēn eudokian tou thelēmatos autou
verses.literal: He predestined us for adoption as His sons . . . . . . through Jesus Christ according to the good pleasure of His will
verses.literalPt: e, em amor, nos predestinou para sermos adotados como filhos por Jesus Cristo para si mesmo, conforme o beneplácito da sua vontade,

verses.original: εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ Ἠγαπημένῳ
verses.transliteration: eis epainon doxēs tēs charitos autou hēs echaritōsen hēmas en tō Ēgapēmenō
verses.literal: to the praise of His glorious grace which He has freely given us in the Beloved One
verses.literalPt: para o louvor da glória da sua graça, a qual nos deu gratuitamente no Amado,

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν διὰ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν παραπτωμάτων κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: en hō echomen tēn apolytrōsin dia tou haimatos autou tēn aphesin tōn paraptōmatōn kata to ploutos tēs charitos autou
verses.literal: In Him we have redemption through His blood the forgiveness of our trespasses according to the riches of His grace
verses.literalPt: no qual temos a nossa redenção pelo seu sangue, a remissão dos nossos delitos, segundo a riqueza da sua graça,

verses.original: ἧς ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ φρονήσει
verses.transliteration: hēs eperisseusen eis hēmas en pasē sophia kai phronēsei
verses.literal: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding
verses.literalPt: a que fez abundar para conosco em toda a sabedoria e prudência,

verses.original: γνωρίσας ἡμῖν τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν αὐτοῦ ἣν προέθετο ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: gnōrisas hēmin to mystērion tou thelēmatos autou kata tēn eudokian autou hēn proetheto en autō
verses.literal: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure which He purposed in Christ
verses.literalPt: fazendo conhecido a nós o mistério da sua vontade, segundo o seu beneplácito que nele propôs,

verses.original: εἰς οἰκονομίαν τοῦ πληρώματος τῶν καιρῶν ἀνακεφαλαιώσασθαι τὰ πάντα ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ τὰ ἐπὶ τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: eis oikonomian tou plērōmatos tōn kairōn anakephalaiōsasthai ta panta en tō Christō ta epi tois ouranois kai ta epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: as a plan for the fullness of time to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ
verses.literalPt: para uma dispensação do cumprimento dos tempos, para reunir todas as coisas em Cristo, as que estão nos céus e as que estão sobre a terra; nele, digo,

verses.original: ἐν αὐτῷ ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν προορισθέντες κατὰ πρόθεσιν τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐνεργοῦντος κατὰ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: en autō en hō kai eklērōthēmen prooristhentes kata prothesin tou ta panta energountos kata tēn boulēn tou thelēmatos autou
verses.literal: In Him - we were also chosen as God’s own having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will
verses.literalPt: no qual também fomos feitos herança, tendo sido predestinados conforme o propósito daquele que faz tudo segundo o conselho da sua vontade,

verses.original: εἰς τὸ εἶναι ἡμᾶς εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης αὐτοῦ τοὺς προηλπικότας ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: eis to einai hēmas eis epainon doxēs autou tous proēlpikotas en tō Christō
verses.literal: in order that we who were the first to hope in Christ would be for the praise of His glory
verses.literalPt: a fim de sermos para o louvor da sua glória, nós que, antes, havíamos esperado em Cristo;

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς σωτηρίας ὑμῶν ἐν ᾧ καὶ πιστεύσαντες ἐσφραγίσθητε τῷ Πνεύματι τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῷ Ἁγίῳ
verses.transliteration: en hō kai hymeis akousantes ton logon tēs alētheias to euangelion tēs sōtērias hymōn en hō kai pisteusantes esphragisthēte tō Pneumati tēs epangelias tō Hagiō
verses.literal: And in Him having heard and believed the word of truth the gospel of your salvation you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: no qual também vós, tendo ouvido a palavra da verdade, o Evangelho da vossa salvação, e nele havendo também crido, fostes selados com o Espírito da promessa, a saber, o Espírito Santo;

verses.original: ὅ ἐστιν ἀρραβὼν τῆς κληρονομίας ἡμῶν εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῆς περιποιήσεως εἰς ἔπαινον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho estin arrabōn tēs klēronomias hēmōn eis apolytrōsin tēs peripoiēseōs eis epainon tēs doxēs autou
verses.literal: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession to the praise of His glory
verses.literalPt: que é penhor da nossa herança, para a redenção da possessão adquirida por Deus, para o louvor da sua glória.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο κἀγώ ἀκούσας τὴν καθ’ ὑμᾶς πίστιν ἐν τῷ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην τὴν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους
verses.transliteration: Dia touto kagō akousas tēn kath’ hymas pistin en tō Kyriō Iēsou kai tēn agapēn tēn eis pantas tous hagious
verses.literal: For this reason . . . ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints
verses.literalPt: Por isso, também eu, tendo ouvido a fé que há entre vós no Senhor Jesus e o vosso amor para com todos os santos,

verses.original: οὐ παύομαι εὐχαριστῶν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν μνείαν ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου
verses.transliteration: ou pauomai eucharistōn hyper hymōn mneian poioumenos epi tōn proseuchōn mou
verses.literal: I have not stopped giving thanks for you remembering you in my prayers
verses.literalPt: não cesso de dar graças por vós, fazendo menção de vós nas minhas orações,

verses.original: ἵνα ὁ Θεὸς τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ Πατὴρ τῆς δόξης δώῃ ὑμῖν πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως ἐν ἐπιγνώσει αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina ho Theos tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou ho Patēr tēs doxēs dōē hymin pneuma sophias kai apokalypseōs en epignōsei autou
verses.literal: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ the glorious Father may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him
verses.literalPt: para que o Deus de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o Pai da glória, vos dê um espírito de sabedoria e de revelação no pleno conhecimento dele,

verses.original: πεφωτισμένους τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εἰδέναι ὑμᾶς τίς ἐστιν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς κλήσεως αὐτοῦ τίς ὁ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις
verses.transliteration: pephōtismenous tous ophthalmous tēs kardias hymōn eis to eidenai hymas tis estin hē elpis tēs klēseōs autou tis ho ploutos tēs doxēs tēs klēronomias autou en tois hagiois
verses.literal: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened so that you may know - the hope of His calling the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints
verses.literalPt: sendo iluminados os olhos do vosso coração, para saberdes vós qual é a esperança da sua vocação, qual a riqueza da glória da sua herança nos santos

verses.original: καὶ τί τὸ ὑπερβάλλον μέγεθος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ εἰς ἡμᾶς τοὺς πιστεύοντας κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ κράτους τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ti to hyperballon megethos tēs dynameōs autou eis hēmas tous pisteuontas kata tēn energeian tou kratous tēs ischyos autou
verses.literal: and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength
verses.literalPt: e qual a suprema grandeza do seu poder para com os que cremos, segundo a operação da força do seu poder,

verses.original: ἣν ἐνήργηκεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐγείρας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ καθίσας ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις
verses.transliteration: hēn enērgēken en tō Christō egeiras auton ek nekrōn kai kathisas en dexia autou en tois epouraniois
verses.literal: which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms
verses.literalPt: que operou ele em Cristo, ressuscitando-o dentre os mortos e fazendo-o sentar-se à sua mão direita nos lugares celestes,

verses.original: ὑπεράνω πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας καὶ δυνάμεως καὶ κυριότητος καὶ παντὸς ὀνόματος ὀνομαζομένου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι
verses.transliteration: hyperanō pasēs archēs kai exousias kai dynameōs kai kyriotētos kai pantos onomatos onomazomenou ou monon en tō aiōni toutō alla kai en tō mellonti
verses.literal: far above all rule and authority power and dominion and every name that is named not only in the present age but also in the one to come
verses.literalPt: muito acima de todo domínio, e autoridade, e poder, e senhorio, e de todo nome que se nomeia não só neste mundo, mas também no que há de vir.

verses.original: καὶ πάντα ὑπέταξεν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν κεφαλὴν ὑπὲρ πάντα τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: kai panta hypetaxen hypo tous podas autou kai auton edōken kephalēn hyper panta tē ekklēsia
verses.literal: And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church
verses.literalPt: Ele lhe sujeitou todas as coisas debaixo dos pés e, para ser cabeça sobre todas as coisas, o deu à Igreja,

verses.original: ἥτις ἐστὶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν πληρουμένου
verses.transliteration: hētis estin to sōma autou to plērōma tou ta panta en pasin plēroumenou
verses.literal: which is His body the fullness of Him who fills all in all
verses.literalPt: a qual é o seu corpo, o complemento daquele que enche tudo em todas as coisas.
